candidates.formal_type:
{A : Type u} →
  [inst : Ring.{u} A] →
    (P : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.{v, max (v + 1) u} (ModuleCat.{v, u} A)) →
      [CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ContainsZero.{v, max u (v + 1)} P] →
        [CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderKernels.{v, max u (v + 1)} P] →
          [CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderCokernels.{v, max u (v + 1)} P] →
            [CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderFiniteProducts.{v, max u (v + 1)} P] →
              Etingof.Abelian.{max u (v + 1), v} (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.{v, max u (v + 1)} P)

∀ (C : Type u) [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian.{v, u} C],
  Exists.{max (u + 2) (v + 2)} fun A =>
    Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun x =>
      Exists.{max (u + 2) (v + 2)} fun P =>
        And (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ContainsZero.{max u v, max (u + 1) (v + 1)} P)
          (And (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms.{max u v, max (u + 1) (v + 1)} P)
            (And (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderFiniteProducts.{max u v, max (u + 1) (v + 1)} P)
              (And (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderFiniteCoproducts.{max u v, max (u + 1) (v + 1)} P)
                (And (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderKernels.{max u v, max (u + 1) (v + 1)} P)
                  (And (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderCokernels.{max u v, max (u + 1) (v + 1)} P)
                    (And
                      (∀ (X Y : ModuleCat.{max u v, max u v} A) (f : Quiver.Hom.{max u v, max (u + 1) (v + 1)} X Y),
                        P X → P Y → P (CategoryTheory.Limits.image.{max u v, max (u + 1) (v + 1)} f))
                      (Nonempty.{max (max (max ((max (u + 1) (v + 1)) + 1) (u + 1)) ((max u v) + 1)) (v + 1)}
                        (CategoryTheory.Equivalence.{v, max u v, u, max (u + 1) (v + 1)} C
                          (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.{max u v, max (u + 1) (v + 1)} P)))))))))

rule: Use primary exactly when the declaration itself states or defines the source claim. Use supporting for prerequisites, constructions, helper lemmas, instances, or consequences that help formalize the item but do not themselves state it.
source_text: The intrinsic abelian axiom is equivalent to realization as a full module subcategory closed under finite sums, kernels, cokernels, and images.
